title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable with three categories, you create three new binary features. Each feature represents one category and takes the value $$1$$ if the observation belongs to that category, and $$0$$ otherwise.

title: Linear Dependence in Features
text: If you add all three one-hot encoded features to the model, they will sum to $$1$$ for each observation. This introduces linear dependence among the features, which can affect the uniqueness of the OLS solution.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Consider the effect of adding all three one-hot encoded features on the model's ability to find a unique solution. What happens when features are linearly dependent?
